result.summary: Bumps the minimum supported Clang compiler version to 19.0 and Xcode Command Line Tools to 26.3 across documentation, CMake, and CI configurations. Replaces the CMake check for CTAD on aggregates with a check for CTAD on alias templates, and sets clang-format to use the latest standard.
result.problem: Supporting older Clang versions requires retaining workarounds for compiler bugs and prevents codebase adoption of C++20 features like Class Template Argument Deduction (CTAD) for alias templates.
evidence: PR description: 'Most supported operating systems ship with clang-19 (or later), so bump the minimum to that and allow new code to drop workarounds for previous clang bugs. (For this bump, only C++20 CTAD will become available.)'
result.changed_since_previous: Updated the CI runner image for ancestor commit tests to warp-ubuntu-2604-x64-8x.
result.card: This pull request raises the minimum supported Clang version to 19.0 and Xcode Command Line Tools to 26.3. It unblocks using C++20 Class Template Argument Deduction for alias templates and allows dropping workarounds for older Clang compiler bugs. The diff updates CMake compiler feature checks, documentation, clang-format configuration, and CI environment jobs.

risk.why: A mistake in the compiler feature detection or CI configuration could break builds or CI runs for developers on specific compiler versions.
